summary: Closes off Alley #614 from 14th Avenue North to its dead end, between Clinton Street and Milson Street, at the request of Marathon Village Strategic Realty Partners LLC. Metro keeps its utility easements there, and building over the utilities needs approval from the transportation and water departments.

judge.problem: The text requires approval from the Director of NDOT and/or the Director of Water and Sewerage Services, plus other pertinent departments, so it does not require both the transportation and water departments. The summary also says the alley is 'closed off', which is a loose description of abandonment of the right-of-way.
